description: The completed open-web first pass captured 27 search invocations and 586 result headers in English, French, Dutch and German. It includes four weekly windows, Brussels and regional/city searches, and labor, education, health, culture, migrant-regularisation, feminist-action and anti-Covid leads. Results remain Brussels-heavy; local and regional archives are not comprehensive, the web method does not reproduce LexisNexis, and this is not an exhaustive absence finding. An original-response audit repaired 14 existing partial/normalized rows and restored one omitted header from hash-verified captures; this added no search. All 27 records now have response-capture times and 15 also have execution timestamps.
required_followup: If coverage is extended, search additional contemporary regional archives and local records across Flanders, Wallonia and the German-speaking community, and retain the open-web versus LexisNexis limitation. Do not treat query counts or empty results as protest=0.

description: Early-February discovery cards S001, S002 and S004 concern a Sunday Brussels anti-Covid assembly and arrests; S004 explicitly dates the described gathering to 31 January. They do not establish a distinct February execution or physical continuation. These leads concern the prior-unit candidate belgium_2021-01_E009; they are not a February candidate. S004 access-check deferred during changing source inputs and its body was not requested.
required_followup: If reopened, run a fresh exact-URL access-check before each body request, verify the reported date, attendance and event identity, and determine any physical continuity. Do not treat arrests as attendance or create a February onset from a February publication date.

required_followup: Coordinator resolves the official baseline and compatibility gate before any export or integration.

description: The Beguinage Church occupation is a cross-month lead with unresolved ownership and threshold. January unit belgium_2021-01_E008 records a Jan 30/31 origin but says the first simultaneous >=50 gathering and public-forum boundary are unresolved. February search cards S014-S016 report an early-February occupation and one search-only count, but the exact BRUZZ and BX1 pages returned HTTP 403 without readable bodies. Opened July VUB/VLIR statement S017 ambiguously says the church and university premises were occupied “since the end of February,” in tension with early-February search leads; it supplies no count or exact onset. No February continuation or event is coded.
required_followup: Resolve the exact occupation timeline, first >=50 simultaneous public assembly, public-forum eligibility and January-versus-February ownership using permitted source bodies. Do not convert unverified search snippets or the ambiguous July retrospective into a February event.

description: Candidate belgium_2021-02_E001 is supported as an executed Feb 13 local gathering above 50 by opened accounts S008 and S011. The Brussels Times attributes around 80 to local police; BX1/Belga reports about 100 activists, so they are not counted as independent turnout confirmation. They name Parvis de Saint-Gilles versus Place Marie Janson, and the organizer/police accounts differ about police containment. Safety and anti-harassment grievances are clear, but an explicit Belgian government recipient or policy remedy is not; eligibility stays pending_state_target. Organizer/eyewitness leads S007 and S010 returned exact-URL HTTP 404 and were not read. The physical end is unknown.
required_followup: Seek permitted body-read evidence for a concrete domestic government or policy target, clarify the exact location and contested police-intervention account without treating Belga copies as independent, and establish the physical end. Keep unknown fields unknown and the candidate pending coordinator review.

description: Opened PTB report S018 describes mixed workplace strikes, mobilizations, awareness actions and car convoys on Feb 25, with wage and early-retirement claims, but gives no site-specific public crowd count. Search-only cards S019-S022 add union/local action leads. S019 exact URL returned HTTP 200, but only the JouwWeb bootstrap prefix was inspected; article text and event facts remain unverified, so the card stays search_only. Its web-open and fallback sequence is retained in the receipt manifest with the missing separate per-attempt receipt disclosed. No eligible public assembly is coded from worker totals, workplace strikes, convoys, notices or this unverified page.
required_followup: Look for permitted after-action reports that identify a public meeting, event-specific simultaneous attendance of at least 50, location and demand recipient. Keep workplace activity, affected workers and planned notices separate from public crowd attendance.
